_note: DERIVED, not shipped by Canyon Code. Built by enumerating every holding surface form in queries.json and resolving each to a ticker by hand. Used for two things only: (1) deciding which tickers the frozen price snapshot must cover, (2) scoring parser output in the evaluation. The B0 LLM parser does NOT see this file -- it is asked to emit tickers directly. The A1 deterministic parser will use it, and that is exactly why the generalization set must contain companies absent from this map.

lookback_phrases._note: Surface form -> days, as used by the corpus generator. Recovered by cross-checking each phrase against expected_lookback_days; every mapping below was verified to agree on 100% of the queries containing it.

policy._note: Applied AFTER parsing, never inside it. queries.json records null when the user stated no window; that null is ground truth for the parser. What the application then does with it is our decision, recorded here so the report can state it.
